facility.name: Kidz Stop
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 804 S 17TH ST, TEMPLE, TX, 76504

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child in care had multiple injuries to their head and the operation staff did not know how the injuries occurred and was unable to intervene to prevent the injury from occurring.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled clothes sent home: During a DFPS investigation, it was found that dirty clothes were not sent home immediately which resulted in the clothes being moldy once sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled clothes sent home (26 TAC §746.3505(g))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food: During a DFPS investigation it was found that the daily sheets did not accurately reflect the feedings of the infants in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times and Amount of Food (26 TAC §746.2431(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Direct Care for No More Than 10 Hours: During the DFPS investigation, it was found that one caregiver is working over 10 hours of direct care of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Direct Care for No More Than 10 Hours (26 TAC §746.1003(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Observed one teacher in the room with 9 infants. The ratio for that age group is 1 teacher per 4 infants. The other teacher was in the office inside the infant room on their lunch break with the door shut. This was corrected when the teacher came back into the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present: During an investigation it was found that a caregiver went on break. Another caregiver supervied two different classrooms during this time, walking back and forth to each classroom
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Caregivers Physically Present (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Observed 2 infants sleeping in rocking chairs. This was corrected when the teachers were asked to put the sleeping infants in their beds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Abserved multiple infants sitting in rocker chairs from 1;27 pm until 3:53. Licensing had told the caregivers at the start of the inspection that the infants can only be in the restrictive devices for 15 minutes and they failed to remove the infants throughout the entire inspection. This was corrected when the infant were removed from the devices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: It was found that infant bottles are washed/rinsed in the sink in the infant room that is also used for handwashing. There was a bottle brush and dish liquid on the sink. I spoke with the caregivers about not washing bottles in their sink in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: Observed an infant (5 months) with a bottle propped with a stuffed animal. This was corrected when the caregiver saw licensing and removed the stuffed animal and picked the infant up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required: During an inspection during naptime, there was not an additional caregiver who was not counted in the child/caregiver ratio. This was corrected once naptime was over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: Observed an infant sleeping in a crib with a bottle. This was corrected when licensing asked the caregiver to remove the bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Observed nails and screws sticking out of the floor of the infant room. A screw was removed from the floor that was sticking up. This was corrected when duct tape was placed over the nails and screws.   Observed an outside door that was rotted at the bottom and splintered. Observed brown water stains in the kitchen, classroom and bathroom areas.   Observed a baseboard coming off the wall in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: Observed a 3 month old infant being fed in a rocking seat while the teacher held the bottle to the infants mouth. This was corrected when Licensing told the caregiver that infants 6 months and younger and any infant who cannot hold their own bottle  must be held to be fed. The infant was taken out of the rocking chair to be held for the rest of the feeding.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Observed children ages 19 months watching Ms. Rachel on a tablet. I spoke with the caregiver about children under the age of two not having screen time. The tablet was turned off during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: During this follow up inspection it was observed that there was a person in a classroom with children without a background check on file.   An administrative penalty will be recommended as a result of this citation, per HRC ?42.078.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: Observed an infant in a crib with a bottle. The bottle was removed from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: One caregiver did not know how many children that they had. The caregiver stated that they should have 11 children, but there was only 10 children in the room. The caregiver counted and stated that one was moved.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Observed a caregiver using thier phone for Tik Tok. This was corrected when the caregiver put the phone away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Observed Lysol and disinfectant spray under an unlocked cabinet in a bathroom that is used by the children in care. This was corrected when the cleaning supplies were removed and placed out of the reach of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: There was two people at the operation without a cleared background check. One person was at the operation for a few hours to answer phones and the other person has been at the operation a couple of days to wash dishes.   An administrative penalty will be imposed in the amount of 100% of the daily maximum per statute, HRC 42.078(a-2).
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operations last sanitation inspection was 5/3/22. I spoke to the director about getting a health inspection each year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Observed the last fire inspection conducted on 5/2/22.   I spoke to the director about ensuring that a fire inspection is completed each month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: During the investigation it was found that a parent was not notified of a minor injury of the child. This was corrected when I spoke to the caregiver about letting the parents know about minor injuries.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: During a walk-through of the childcare facility, an infant was observed using infant equipment and the safety straps were not fastened. The infant was immediately removed from the equipment when addressed bringing the facility into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During a walk-through of the childcare facility, a toddler classroom was out of ratio by one child. A child was removed from that classroom and placed into another classroom, bringing the toddler classroom ratio into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Three children were observed using equipment that was equipped with safety straps and the safety straps were not fastened. The safety straps were immediately fastened when addressed, bringing the facility into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: After a review of employee files, there was no educational documentation to determine if employees met the educational requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: After a review of employee files, there were no affidavits for applicants for employment on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: After a review of children's records, a child enrolled in care did not have a physician's health statement on file for review. The child was enrolled in care in January of 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: A 16-month-old infant was observed to be asleep in an infant crib with a bottle. The bottle was immediately removed from the crib, bringing the facility into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age: Based on information obtained through an investigation, a non-walking infant was observed in a bassinet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward: Based on information obtained through an investigation, the childcare facility used a type of food as a reward.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward (26 TAC §746.3301(h))
